items.summary: POST /charge calls Stripe /v1/charges with no Idempotency-Key header and records no order or payment attempt, so a retry or timeout can charge twice (playbook ST-5). The amount is also computed from client-supplied price and qty (ST-2), and it uses the legacy Charges API.
items.fix: Create an order row server-side with a unique constraint, then pass its id as the Idempotency-Key header on the Stripe call. Move to PaymentIntents or Checkout with server-side price lookup.

items.summary: /charge has no server-side deduplication: no order or attempt table, no lock, no unique constraint. There is no front end in the repo, so no UI protection is visible either.
items.fix: Add a unique open payment attempt per order or cart in the database and reject or replay duplicates. Also disable the Pay button in the UI.

items.summary: There is no Stripe webhook endpoint, so payment state is not driven by signed provider events (ST-1, ST-4). /charge just returns the Stripe response and nothing records payment state. The Stripe secret key is also hard-coded in source (a fake fixture value here; a real one would need rotating).
items.fix: Add a POST /stripe/webhook route using express.raw and stripe.webhooks.constructEvent with the endpoint secret. Store processed event ids and grant entitlement only from checkout.session.completed or payment_intent.succeeded. Load keys from environment variables.
